name: disk-interno-monorepo
description: Disk Interno PDT - Plataforma Unificada de Operações DiskIngressos

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/web && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true, force:true});"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run build --prefix backend && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true, force:true});"

author: DiskIngressos
